1# define a function to find the permutation of a string
2def get_permutation(string, i=0):
3
4    # if i is the length of the string, print the string
5    if i == len(string):
6        print(''.join(string))
7
8    # otherwise, for each character in the string,
9    # swap it with the character at index i and recurse
10    for j in range(i, len(string)):
11
12        words = [c for c in string]
13        # swap
14        words[i], words[j] = words[j], words[i]
15
16        # function recursion
17        get_permutation(words, i + 1)
18
19# call the function
20get_permutation('pan')
